extraction_warnings: Paper reports only group-level aggregate data (control, pHTN, HTN, n=41/56/99); no per-subject or per-sample rows are available, so sample-level fields (subject_id, sample_id, age, sex) could not be extracted.
Specific demographic details (age, BMI, sex distribution) are stated to reside in Additional file 1: Table S1, which was not provided in the extracted text.
Sequencing platform model (HiSeq vs other) is explicitly stated only for 16S rRNA sequencing of transplanted mice samples, not for the human shotgun metagenomic sequencing.
PMID and study_name were not stated within the paper text; paper_id was supplied externally as 28143587.

Human participant age (years) was not numerically reported in the provided text; only mouse recipient age (8-10 weeks) was found (Methods — Animal experiments), and is reported under age_min/age_max with a clarifying note.

fmt_role field required custom subgroup keys (FMT_donor, FMT_recipient_mice) that do not match the main study subgroups (control/pHTN/HTN) because the FMT experiment involves a different donor/recipient structure (human donors, mouse recipients).
smoker and antibiotics_current_use fields were inferred from exclusion criteria rather than direct statements of participant status; confidence set to medium.

BMI, dietary_restriction, and detailed demographic values (age, gender ratios) are referenced as analyzed covariates but exact figures are only in supplementary tables (Additional file 1: Table S1) not included in the provided text.
feces_phenotype and fmt_id fields could not be matched to any explicit text in the provided excerpt; marked not_reported.

Schema fields (biomarker_*, ecog_performance_status, disease_response_os, tumor_size_*, feces_phenotype_value) appear designed for oncology/clinical trial studies and are largely not applicable to this gut microbiota-hypertension paper.

Blood pressure (SBP/DBP) thresholds used for group classification were mapped to 'biomarker' fields as the closest quantifiable clinical measure reported in the paper; this is an interpretive choice given the generic schema.
Actual numeric biomarker values (e.g., mean SBP/DBP per group, FBG levels) were not given in the main text but likely reside in Additional file 1: Table S1, which was not provided.

The study includes both human participants and germ-free mice (as FMT recipients); host_species field only allows a single string, so 'human' was chosen as primary host species with mice noted in field notes.
